title: Dispatch scorecard
subtitle: How stores, and the staff who answer for them, handled competed deliveries over a range — ranked, with the bids behind every figure.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the dispatch scorecard
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the dispatch scorecard grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

problem.incomplete: Pick both ends of the range.
problem.reversed: The range ends before it starts.
problem.tooLong: A range is at most <max>{{max}}</max> days.

refusal.rangeTooLong: The server refused the range: it is longer than 92 days.
refusal.rangeReversed: The server refused the range: it ends before it starts.
refusal.unknownFigure: The server does not know that figure, so its bids cannot be listed.
refusal.storeRequired: A store is needed for its report card.

list.failedTitle: The scorecard could not be loaded
list.failed: Something went wrong reading the scorecard. Try again in a moment.
list.empty: No competed bids in this range.

note.stores: Click a ranked header twice for best and worst. A store needs <n>{{n}}</n> answered or ignored bids to rank; below that it reads “too few” and sorts last. Beaten and withdrawn bids are out of every rate. Any underlined figure opens the bids behind it.
note.staff: A person is ranked on their own Takes and Passes only — never on ignores, which are the store’s. <n>{{n}}</n> answers are needed to rank; below that the row sorts last.

columnHint.lostRaces: A near miss is a lost race at most 10 seconds after the award — poll luck, not slowness.
columnHint.unseen: Bids never shown: nobody signed in, or a till on an old build.
columnHint.releasedAfterAward: Awarded deliveries this store won and later released; hover a figure for its reasons.
columnHint.failedTakeRate: Of the deliveries this store won, how many it then closed itself, or a courier cancelled with a reason that names the store. Lower is better. A store with no wins shows —.
columnHint.fallbackCancels: Deliveries this store got as a fallback and then closed. Not in the rate.
columnHint.refusedCloses: Deliveries this store won and then tried to close while the lock held them. Each delivery counts once. Not in the rate.

drill.failedTitle: The bids could not be loaded

drill.countedHint: For a rate, every row is in its denominator; Counted marks its numerator.
drill.tillsHint: Tills online / signed in when the bid was offered.
drill.attemptsSwept: Attempts older than 6 months are no longer kept. The count still stands.

closes.title: Closes after a take

cause.OtherClose: Someone else (HQ, customer channel or system): see Closed by
